raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  build_number: 1
  name: tree-sitter-language-pack
  version: "1.17.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 4da68262d7f594587e748e462e689dc57eed1f7fb0c0680606ae6a665cacfc42
  - url: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/releases/download/v${{ version }}/parser-sources-${{ version }}.tar.zst
    sha256: 76f788c0df31ebb8d4ea8105c326b6f3ee96dae381f552576b5b57446422b3a8
    target_directory: _parser_sources

build:
  script:
    # The static build is REQUIRED, not an optimisation. Upstream ships the
    # typst scanner buffer-overflow fix as an in-tree patch under patches/typst/,
    # which build.rs applies ONLY when grammars are compiled from source — i.e.
    # only when TSLP_LINK_MODE=static. In the default dynamic mode the package
    # downloads PREBUILT grammar binaries that still contain the bug, and
    # test_smoke_typst segfaults (SIGSEGV, exit 139). Do not remove this wiring.
    # TSLP_LANGUAGES=all is also load-bearing: build.rs embeds each language's
    # queries only for languages it compiles, so a narrower value silently
    # strips highlights/folds/indents/injections/locals/tags from the rest.
    env:
      TSLP_LANGUAGES: all
      TSLP_LINK_MODE: static
      TSLP_OFFLINE: "1"
    content:
      - mv _parser_sources/parsers parsers
      - cd packages/python
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ../../THIRDPARTY.yml
      - if: ppc64le
        then:
          - export CFLAGS_powerpc64le_unknown_linux_gnu="${CFLAGS}"
          - export CXXFLAGS_powerpc64le_unknown_linux_gnu="${CXXFLAGS}"
          - unset CFLAGS CXXFLAGS
      - if: riscv64
        then:
          - export CFLAGS_riscv64gc_unknown_linux_gnu="${CFLAGS}"
          - export CXXFLAGS_riscv64gc_unknown_linux_gnu="${CXXFLAGS}"
          - unset CFLAGS CXXFLAGS
      - if: osx and x86_64
        then:
          - export CFLAGS_x86_64_apple_darwin="${CFLAGS}"
          - export CXXFLAGS_x86_64_apple_darwin="${CXXFLAGS}"
          - unset CFLAGS CXXFLAGS
      - maturin build --release --interpreter ${{ PYTHON }} --out ${{ "${SRC_DIR}/dist" if unix else "%SRC_DIR%\dist" }}
      - cd ../..
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install --find-links=dist tree_sitter_language_pack
  number: ${{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - crossenv
        - maturin
        - python
  host:
    - maturin
    - pip
    - python
  run:
    - python
    - tree_sitter >=0.23.2
    - tree-sitter-c-sharp >=0.23.1
    - tree-sitter-embedded-template >=0.23.2
    - tree-sitter-yaml >=0.7.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - tree_sitter_language_pack
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - ${{ '' if unix else 'set TREE_SITTER_LANGUAGE_PACK_CACHE_DIR=%TEMP%/tslp-cache' }}
      - pytest e2e/python/tests
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - pytest-asyncio
        - pytest-timeout
        - python
    files:
      source:
        - e2e/python/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack
  summary: 'Comprehensive tree-sitter grammar compilation with polyglot bindings'
  description: |
    Comprehensive tree-sitter grammar compilation with polyglot bindings —
    Rust, Python, Node.js, Go, Java, Ruby, Elixir, PHP, C#, WASM, Dart,
    Kotlin-Android, Swift, Zig, and CLI. 371 languages.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  repository: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
    - pavelzw
